name: Fishing Spot
description: Daily fishing index for a dovepescare.com spot that you choose: score, water and air temperature, wind, pressure, rain, flow or waves, moon and the species in season
config_help:
Shows the daily fishing index of one spot from [dovepescare.com](https://dovepescare.com). Nothing shows until you set a spot.

**Spot.** Open the spot on dovepescare.com and copy its address, the part after `/spot/`. For `https://dovepescare.com/spot/panaro-a-vignola/`, write `panaro-a-vignola`. You can also paste the full address.

day.name: Day
day.description: Which forecast day the index is calculated for
